🛡️ **F-SRV-4 (attended 2026-10-31; the owner: "Can you check that the server is up to date? There were a lot of security issues (CVEs) recently") — THE GOLD RUSH SERVICES ARE CURRENT; THE ONE EXPOSURE ON THE BOX IS A LEFTOVER: THE OLD AGENT TOWN LANDING, PUBLIC ON PORT 4173, AS ROOT, ON NODE 18.** Measured read-only over ssh at 15:35Z: apt zero pending (security and updates); unattended-upgrades took nginx 1.24.0-2ubuntu7.19 on 2026-10-24 by itself (CVE-2026-15176, CVE-2026-93479, CVE-2026-97205 and the session-ticket forgery CVE-2026-97629; 7.18 had closed CVE-2026-42533 and CVE-2026-95101); kernel 6.8.0-147 running and newest, no reboot flag; OpenSSL 3.0.13-0ubuntu3.16 carries the high DTLS fix CVE-2026-84782; OpenSSH 9.6p1-3ubuntu13.20 (the deferred CVE-2026-110928 needs `restrict` keys, and none of the five root keys carries one); Node 26.12.1 on ledger and assayer (26.13.0 of 2026-10-28 is not a security release, the newest nodejs.org advisory is still October's, already covered by F-SRV-2); `/opt/goldrush` npm audit 0 of 47 packages; assayer refusals 0 and backoffs 1 in seven days. The four untriaged nginx CVEs (CVE-2026-116013, -101025, -101019, -108981) name the lua-dns, njs and cache-purge modules: none installed. THE EXPOSURE: `pm2-root.service` (enabled, active) resurrects `/root/code/landing-main/server/index.js`, the beta-onboarding landing from the box's first day, as root on the system `nodejs` 18.19.1 (universe; 9 of the newest 15 nodejs CVEs are needs-triage there), Express 4 with five npm advisories (critical proxy-addr IP spoofing, high body-parser and path-to-regexp DoS, two moderate qs), bound to `*:4173`, HTTP 200 from the internet over plain HTTP (ufw inactive; no cloud firewall fronts the droplet), with POST routes that write `data/store.json`. Nothing uses it: the store is unchanged since 2026-02-02, its log holds seven lines, zero connections; agenttown.app's root serves Gold Rush from nginx (`root /opt/goldrush/site`). Also measured: 2,124 failed ssh logins in 24 h against key-only authentication (noise, not a breach), and the 2026-10-30 16:32Z reboot was a clean systemd reboot following a root login from this network. GATE: owner word "landing go" (`GR_OWNER_APPLY=1 bash scripts/attended/droplet-maintenance.sh landing-stop`; rollback is pm2 resurrect from the stamped dump copy) and "firewall go" (`… firewall`: ufw deny incoming except 22/80/443). Both gated phases landed in this commit; recommended both.

🔺 **F-2299-1 — OWNER'S DESK (2026-09-24, from the rotation check after the owner's "Ok, I updaed all the keys"): the rotation's last mile: two new values into `.env.local`, and the Claude Code token still the exposed one.** VERIFIED 2026-09-24 read-only, no value printed or copied: the edge API token in `.env.local` is DEAD at its provider (the token-verify endpoint answers `1000 Invalid API Token`) and the voice key is DEAD (`HTTP 401` on the user endpoint), so both rotations happened at the providers; but `.env.local` was last written 2026-09-20, so the file `scripts/deploy.sh` sources still holds the dead values and **every deploy aborts at the wrangler auth until the owner pastes the new `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=` and `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=` lines** (a failed deploy in a fire log until then is THIS, not a regression; do not file it). The fires' own credential, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (the "coding-agent subscription token" of ruling 1), still authenticates through the fires' exact path (`claude auth status` under `~/.claude-fires` reads loggedIn; a one-word `-p` probe answered), so the value exposed on 2026-08-25 is STILL LIVE: the owner mints a new one (`claude setup-token`), pastes it as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=`, and revokes the old one in his account; the attended session re-probes and closes. The droplet holds no stray copy (`find / -name .env.local` empty, `/opt/goldrush/.env.local` absent, read-only over the deploy's own ssh path). The Codex login was refreshed today (`~/.codex/auth.json`, "Logged in using ChatGPT"). Retires when: both new values answer live to the same read-only calls, the Claude probe passes on a NEW value (`.env.local` rewritten) and the owner says the old one is revoked. The original finding is the F-2299-1 row of s2299 below. ➡️ **UPDATE 2026-09-24 18:15 local (owner: "I rotated all tokens in the .env.local file", "I rolled it again"):** the owner rotated all three at the providers and minted a new Claude Code token, but pasted twice into the sibling folder's copy (`Gold Rush-history-local/.env.local`, the pre-rewrite local history), which nothing reads; the attended session found it by mtime, verified its values read-only (Cloudflare `active`, ElevenLabs `200`, the new Claude token answers through the fires' path, per-line hashes: the three rotated lines DIFFERENT, the account id, the router key and the droplet host identical), backed the old root file up outside every git tree (`~/.goldrush/env.local.bak-2026-09-24`, mode 600; a `.bak` beside `.env.local` would NOT be gitignored) and copied the edited file into the repo root; re-verified from the root: Cloudflare `active`, ElevenLabs `200`, Claude `ok`, `wrangler whoami` logged in. DEPLOYS UNBLOCKED. STILL OPEN: the Claude Code token exposed on 2026-08-25 still authenticated at 18:14 when probed from the old file, so it is not revoked; the desk item narrows to that one revocation (the owner's account settings), verified afterwards by the same probe against the backup. ➡️ **UPDATE 2026-09-24 23:2x local (owner, verbatim: "I used the log out of all devices button in the web ui. Then I logged in again, logged in here, then did claude setup-token, copied it in .env.local and then told you done."):** MEASURED, not inferred: after that button, the August token (from the backup) and the 18:13 token (minted before the button) BOTH still answer through the fires' auth path; the button ends browser and CLI sessions (this CLI needed `/login`) but does not revoke long-lived `claude setup-token` tokens. The CLI cannot revoke either (`claude auth logout` clears local credentials only; the only revoke code in the binary is a bundled Google OAuth library; the account endpoints refuse the token with `permission_error`, so its e-mail cannot be read from the token; every login recorded on this Mac is `robin@brainstem.health`, and the fires' config dir dates from 2026-07-08, so the token was minted on or before that day). The newest token (23:16) had again gone to the sibling folder's file; copied into the repo root with the 18:15 root kept at `~/.goldrush/env.local.bak-2026-09-24-1815` (mode 600); root re-verified: Claude ok, Cloudflare active, ElevenLabs 200. REMAINING, owner-side: an Anthropic support request to revoke the Claude Code token minted on or before 2026-07-08 for `robin@brainstem.health` (the exposed one; the 2026-09-24 tokens stay), or its natural expiry; the attended session re-probes from the backup and closes the row when it fails. Exposure bound meanwhile: inference on the owner's subscription only (the account endpoints refuse it). ➡️ **SUPPORT REQUEST ISSUED (owner 2026-09-25, verbatim: "support request is issued"):** the revocation of the August Claude Code token is with Anthropic support; the attended session re-probes the backup token each session (`claude -p ok` under the fires' config from `~/.goldrush/env.local.bak-2026-09-24`) and closes this row, retires the desk item and removes both backup files (owner's word; `rm` prompts) on the first refusal. Until then: live, inference scope only. RULED 2026-09-26 (verbatim "D - as you recommend it"): the attended session keeps re-probing the backup token and retires this row, removing both backup files, on the first refusal.

✅ **F-REV-1 — OWNER'S DESK (2026-09-24, from the outside review of the project): ten decisions the review leaves with you.** ✅ RULED 2026-09-24 (see the OWNER RULINGS row above)  The review (86 findings, three verification passes the same day; the verdicts in `docs/REVIEW-RESPONSE-2026-09-24.md`) is fair: the game code at C, the machinery at D. Yours: (1) rotate the three credentials with no record since 2026-08-25 (F-2299-1); (2) the live seed: humans play every contract on the seed `gold-rush` and never ride the weekly rotation, options rotation-per-contract / random-per-run / both, recommendation the rotation; (3) the era-bump day for seeding the browser's harvest from the run seed (the two engines disagree from tick 0, against your 2026-09-07 fairness ruling); (4) the Workers Paid plan for the KV budget (about $5 a month); (5) a droplet evening for root services, sandboxing and the real client IP; (6) the history rewrite for the nine commits carrying a personal address (0 forks today); (7) CI on your GitHub account (a three-step workflow); (8) the shape of the ledgers under the retention law (dated STATUS archives, a BACKLOG index plus per-epic files, anchors instead of line numbers); (9) evidence offload to the archive repo or a bucket; (10) the ten-minute phone measurement (B1). 🔐 **F-2386-1 — A PLAINTEXT COPY OF A LIVE CREDENTIAL SITS ONE DIRECTORY ABOVE THE REPO, AT MODE 644, AND EVERY INSTRUMENT THIS FACTORY OWNS IS BLIND TO IT BY CONSTRUCTION (measured s2386).** `/Users/robin/Claude/Projects/Gold` — note the path, it is not a directory — is a **93 B** file, mode **644**, mtime **2026-07-31T21:50 local**, holding one line: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY=<73 chars>`. 🔑 **THE MECHANISM IS CERTAIN, BECAUSE THE IDENTICAL BUG BIT THE FIRE THAT FOUND IT, IN THE SAME SESSION: the repo path contains a SPACE.** An unquoted `> /Users/robin/Claude/Projects/Gold Rush/.env.local` writes to `.../Gold` and passes `Rush/.env.local` as a second word; s2386 typed an unquoted `sed -n 1p /Users/robin/Claude/Projects/Gold Rush/scripts/law-surfaces.mjs`, sed took `.../Gold` as its first file operand, and **printed the key into the fire transcript.** ⚖️ **SEVERITY STATED HONESTLY AND DELIBERATELY NOT INFLATED — THREE THINGS THIS IS NOT.** (1) **NOT a sixth credential**: the value is **byte-identical** to `.env.local`'s `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (sha256 prefix `3d6eacd97ccdce34`, compared by hash, no value printed), so it is a DUPLICATE of one of F-2299-1's five and that item's rotation neutralises it. (2) **NOT a repo exposure**: the path is outside the Gold Rush repo AND `/Users/robin/Claude/Projects` is **not a git repo at all**, so it can never be committed; the value appears in **0 of 24,518 tracked files** (full-content scan, not a name grep). (3) **NOT newly disclosed by the transcript leak**: `logs/fire-*.log` is untracked and ignored (authoritative `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` test, F-2358-1 — **0** tracked fire logs exist), and F-2299-1 §4 already rules this key must be treated as disclosed because it sat on a public-IP box. **Realised cost is almost certainly ZERO on a single-user Mac.** 🎯 **WHAT EARNS IT A LINE IS THREE THINGS THE DESK CANNOT SEE TODAY.** (a) **The copy is strictly MORE readable than the original the factory protects** — 644 against `.env.local`'s 600, i.e. world-readable where the guarded one is not. (b) **It SHARPENS F-2299-1's cleanup scope**: that item names `.env.local` and the droplet, so "rotate the five and clean up" leaves this file behind — and a stale post-rotation file that LOOKS like config is how a dead key gets pasted back into a live one. (c) **It is invisible to every instrument the factory has, and not by neglect**: `git ls-files --others` cannot see outside the repo, `art-staging-audit` scans declared sinks, F-2357-1's evidence read is scoped to `artifacts/ reviews/`, and `ledger-mirror-exposure` reads mirrors. Every one is correct within its own root. 💡 **THE REUSABLE HALF, AND IT IS A NEW AXIS FOR THIS STREAK'S OWN QUESTION.** Twenty-plus fires have asked *how can this subject set come back EMPTY?* — a throw, a `catch`, a guard, a stale tree, a cwd, a filename, an orthogonal selector. **This one is none of them: the corpus is complete and correct, and the ARTIFACT IS OUTSIDE ITS ROOT.** Every instrument here is repo-rooted, so a sibling path is outside all of them *simultaneously and by construction* — and the more instruments you add, the more confidently the board reports clean. **When every tool is anchored to one root, ask once what lives just outside it.** 🚫 **NO GUARD IS PROPOSED AND THE RESTRAINT IS MEASURED RATHER THAN LAZY: a scanner that reached outside the repo root would have no bounded corpus — it would be sweeping the owner's home directory for secrets, which is worse than the defect and cannot be gated lawfully. A file outside the repo is also not something a repo gate has any standing to police.** ⓘ Verified consumed by nothing: **0** tracked files reference that path as a terminal path (precise test, excluding the escaped `Gold\ Rush` and `%20` forms that fill the STATUS archives — and whose ubiquity is itself evidence the space hazard is known and routinely escaped). ➡️ **OWNER ACTION, and it is why this is a desk item rather than a fire's fix: both halves are owner-only. Deleting needs approval (`rm` is gated by law, and this is the owner's file outside the repo) and rotation is an external service (§7.3).** rec — **(a)** `rm '/Users/robin/Claude/Projects/Gold'`: it is a typo artifact, read by nothing, and its sibling `.env.local` is the real config; **(b)** fold the key into the F-2299-1 rotation you are already owed, which covers it. **Nothing is blocked either way and no fire is waiting on this.**

🔺 **F-2299-1 OPEN, NARROWED 2026-09-24 to the Claude Code token and two local pastes (the desk row at the top) — OWNER (s2299 2026-08-25): THE DROPLET SYNC SHIPPED FIVE LIVE CREDENTIALS, AND THE LEAK WAS IN THE RUNBOOK'S OWN RECIPE, NOT THE NEW LEG — CURED ONE LINE, BUT A COPY MAY ALREADY BE ON THE BOX.** Executing F-2298-1's recommendation (a) on a dry board. **Measured LOCAL and READ-ONLY: no ssh to production, nothing deployed, no credential VALUE read, printed or committed.** 🔑 **CORRECTION 1 — THE PAYLOAD IS FIVE CREDENTIALS, NOT ONE.** `.env.local` (428 B, mode 600, untracked, `.gitignore:3`) carries `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, `CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and **`CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` — the factory's own Claude subscription credential, i.e. the thing that pays for every fire and every lane runner.** F-2298-1 priced this as "a live Cloudflare token"; the desk was under-informed by four keys. 🔑 **CORRECTION 2, AND IT IS THE ONE THAT MOVES THE DECISION — THE LEG IS NOT A DIVERGENCE FROM THE RUNBOOK.** F-2298-1 read `docs/ops/agenttown-server.md:40`'s allowlist and called the denylist a divergence. **The runbook contains BOTH recipes: an allowlist at `:40` and, at `:57`, a denylist that is BYTE-IDENTICAL to `deploy.sh:170` after normalising whitespace and `--timeout=60`** (verified by extracting both strings from their files and comparing, not by eye). ➡️ **So the exposure is NOT a defect the new leg introduced — it is a defect in the DOCUMENTED HAND RECIPE, which predates the leg and which the owner may have run at any time since the box was set up. The exposure window is therefore not "since 12:21 today"; it is UNKNOWN.** That is why the cure had to land in BOTH files (fix the CLASS, not the instance). ✅ **PROVEN SENT, THEN PROVEN FIXED, BY MEASUREMENT AND NOT BY READING THE EXCLUDE LIST:** a local `rsync --dry-run` reproducing the leg's exact exclude set — **read out of `deploy.sh` at run time rather than retyped, so the probe cannot drift from its subject** — lists `.env.local` in the transfer set pre-cure and not post-cure; **55,661 → 55,660 files, EXACTLY ONE REMOVED**, which is the whole evidence for "strictly subtractive". ⓘ **The probe asserted its own validity first (F-2215-1) and this was not decorative: its first run returned `0 lines` and REFUSED rather than reporting a clean result, because `rsync -n` prints nothing without an itemiser. A probe whose failure mode is an empty list is indistinguishable from good news.** 🛠️ **CURE: `--exclude .env.local` in `scripts/deploy.sh:170` AND in the runbook's `:57` recipe (`909d8c4ae`). Provably safe: nothing box-side reads that file — `goldrush-assay.service` takes `/etc/goldrush-assay.env` (runbook `:32`), `goldrush-ledger.service` uses `EnvironmentFile=/etc/goldrush-ledger.env` (`:60`), both OUTSIDE the synced tree, which is exactly where the leg's own `sed -i` writes; and `grep -rn "env.local" server/ scripts/assay-worker* scripts/ledger*` returns ZERO hits.** `bash -n scripts/deploy.sh` parses clean. ⚖️ **WHY A FIRE ACTED WHERE s2298 CORRECTLY DID NOT, STATED PLAINLY SO THE OWNER CAN VETO IT: s2298's three reasons were re-measured rather than inherited, and two no longer hold.** Its reason (3) — *"the obvious cure is subtly wrong"* — is about the ALLOWLIST rewrite and **explicitly does not apply to (a)**; its reason (2), *"attended may still be iterating"*, is refuted by measurement (`deploy.sh` unchanged since `3ff1eb606`, clean vs HEAD, 30 min quiet). Only §7.3 remained, and **this is not a deployment act** — it is a one-line subtractive edit to a pipeline script, reversible, inside CLAUDE.md §2's directly-implementable set, taken under §7.4 (owner absent + reversible) with this veto line. **It forecloses nothing: (b) and (c) stay fully open.** 🚨 **WHAT THE CURE DOES NOT DO, AND IT BOUNDS THE OWNER'S REMAINING WORK: rsync PROTECTS excluded names from `--delete` — the same property s2298 used to refute the `node_modules` scare — so if any earlier run of the runbook's `:57` recipe already placed `.env.local` on the box, THIS FIX WILL NOT REMOVE IT.** ❓ **UNCLOSEABLE FROM THIS DISK: whether a copy is already there needs ssh to production, which a fire has no authorization for.** **One word, and the first half is a two-minute check: (a) `ssh root@<droplet> 'ls -la /opt/goldrush/.env.local'` — if it exists, `rm` it AND ROTATE ALL FIVE CREDENTIALS, because a token that has sat on a public-IP box is disclosed whether or not anyone read it · (b) treat the box as clean on the grounds that the leg never ran and the hand recipe was never used · (c) rotate regardless, as cheap insurance. Recommendation (a) — it is one command and it converts an UNKNOWN into a fact.** ⓘ **Do NOT read this row as closing F-2298-1: the 7.73 GB payload, the allowlist fork, and the missing `ConnectTimeout` on the second `ssh` are all still open there.** Evidence: `artifacts/f2299-1-env-local-exposure/note.md` (reproduce recipe §5, ~10 s, local, no network).

🔺 **F-2329-1 OPEN — OWNER (s2329 2026-08-26): A VERIFIED, LIVE DEPLOY IS RECORDED AS `interrupted` IN THE ONLY MACHINE-READABLE CHANNEL, AND THE ASSAYER LEG DIED SILENTLY INSIDE IT — SO THE ENGINE/ASSAYER SKEW F-2296-1 NAMES MAY BE LIVE RIGHT NOW.** Measured LOCAL and READ-ONLY on a dry board: no ssh to production, nothing deployed, no credential value read. 📊 **THE TWO CHANNELS DISAGREE, AND ONLY ONE IS MACHINE-READABLE.** `logs/deploy.log` records `08:40:24 DEPLOYED ok https://655390f8.gold-rush-3in.pages.dev`, then `08:40:26 VERIFY attempt 1/7: … says ccedf620`, then `08:40:26 VERIFIED published ccedf620 at https://gold-rush-3in.pages.dev` — that is s2327’s handoff commit `ccedf6200`, live and confirmed against the production alias. `logs/deploy-result.json` records `{"outcome":"interrupted","url":"","publishedBuild":"ccedf620","commit":"ccedf6200…","ts":"2026-08-26T01:43:06Z"}`. ⏱️ **The timestamps are in DIFFERENT ZONES and both are correct, which is why this is easy to misread: the result file writes true UTC (`date -u`, `deploy.sh:19`) while the log writes local (`date '+%F %T'`, `:14`), so `01:43:06Z` IS `08:43:06+07` — i.e. the `interrupted` verdict was written 2m40s AFTER the deploy was verified live.** 🕳️ **THE RUN DIED INSIDE THE ASSAYER LEG, PROVEN BY ABSENCE: the log ENDS at the VERIFIED line, and NONE of the leg’s three declarations appear — `ASSAYER SYNCED` (`deploy.sh:177`), `ASSAYER SYNC FAILED mid-step` (`:179`), `ASSAYER NOT SYNCED (box unreachable)` (`:182`).** The leg is entered at `:174` and the success path exits at `finish deployed 0` (`:184`), so the process was killed between those two lines; the traps at `:43`–`:45` (`HUP`/`INT`/`TERM` → `finish interrupted`) are what wrote a result file at all, and they emit no `note`, so the log gets nothing. ✅ **SAME-DAY INTERNAL CONTROL, SAME BOX, SAME LEG, 100 MINUTES EARLIER — so this is a divergence from a proven baseline, not an untested path: `07:00:14 DEPLOYED ok` → `07:00:15 VERIFIED published d4458867` → `07:00:31 ASSAYER SYNCED: droplet tree + pin d4458867, services restarted`. The leg completed in SIXTEEN SECONDS and the box was reachable that morning.** ⚖️ **SEVERITY STATED HONESTLY AND DELIBERATELY NOT INFLATED — THE PLAYER-FACING DEPLOY SUCCEEDED. `ccedf620` is verified live at the production alias; NOTHING IS BROKEN FOR THE PLAYER and this row must not be read as a failed deploy.** What is wrong is the RECORD and the ASSAYER half.
